data.note: Grants the Druidic language. v0 surfaces this as a language proficiency flag; full language tracking isn't yet wired through derive.ts.
SRD 5.2: Choose Magician or Warden at L1. Player pick stored in character.featureChoices.primal-order.feature.feature; the chosen sub-feature row is loaded by the engine.
SRD 5.2 Magician: Extra druid cantrip (pick from SRD druid cantrips) + add Wisdom modifier to all Arcana and Nature checks. Wis bonus to both skills is wired directly.
SRD 5.2 Warden: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training in Medium armor.
Expend a Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar (as a ritual) summoning a Fey spirit for 1 hour. The Find Familiar effect isn't simulated by v0; the resource and a utility activity are surfaced.
Full statblock replacement is out-of-scope for v0 (see docs/rules-engine.md What v0 does not handle). The resource and a utility activity are surfaced; the actual form/CR table isn't modelled.
Placeholder for Druid Circle selection (Land / Moon / Sea / Stars in 2024 SRD 5.2). The chosen subclass slug lives on character.classes[].subclass.

Two legs: (A) Once per turn, if you have no Wild Shape uses remaining, you can expend a spell slot of any level to regain one Wild Shape use — this is unlimited but gated per-turn; (B) Once per Long Rest, expend one Wild Shape use to regain one expended level-1 spell slot. v0 surfaces leg B as a 1/long-rest utility activity; leg A (per-turn, spell-slot-funded) is left to UI adjudication and cannot be expressed in the current activity DSL.

activities.name: Wild Resurgence (regain spell slot from Wild Shape)
activities.note: Expend 1 Wild Shape use to regain a level-1 spell slot. Once per Long Rest.
